title: Visibility and Encapsulation
summary: Struct fields and functions are private by default, requiring pub to be exposed.
lecture: In Rust, items and struct fields are private to their module by default.
Making a struct `pub` does not make its fields public. Each field needs `pub` explicitly.
Enums are different. When an enum is public, all of its variants and fields are public.

example.caption: Field x is public, field y is private.
